authorization: User requested implementation, reliability preflight and subsequent comparison; comparison depends on passing preflight.
interface: Public execute definitions and actual effect receipts shared by every condition; never expose rubric or unread observation values.
fairness: Summary receives matching semantic preservation guidance and same one-repair cap. V0.2 means old representation/extraction prompt under the new common interface, budget and recovery protocol, not replay of old end-to-end system.
limits: Known regression inputs and workflows were previously inspected; no unseen-generalization claim.
Versions combine multiple design changes; not a causal ablation of an individual field.
Preflight cases are new short synthetic fixtures; semantic audit is not independent researcher review.
One repetition outside preflight; no statistical equivalence claims.
Repair and all execution calls count; protocol errors remain in assigned denominators.
Raw bytes are not provider tokens, cached inputs and latency are reported separately.
failure_policy: Keep failures; no performance-selective reruns or post-result prompt tuning. Failed gate stops before comparison. Provider errors stop current run with unknown usage distinguished; no incomplete performance claims.
